verdict.rationale: treg is an agent-tool gateway, so bridging a local MCP server into it as a managed remote connection is a fair question. The evidence only shows treg's own hosted MCP endpoint and `treg upload clis`, which turns local CLIs into team tools. Neither is a way to tunnel or register a locally running MCP server, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
